evidence.text: Fits residuals v_ℓ=A C_ℓ^o−B C_ℓ^CMB,th with a quadratic likelihood and emcee MCMC using flat angle priors. Covariance comes from observed spectra, binned at Δℓ=20, with an approximate mask correction based on the fourth root of four sky fractions.

evidence.text: Exploit different rotations of CMB and foreground polarization: α_i + β_i for the CMB and α_i for foregrounds. A multichannel rotation-matrix relation and Metropolis MCMC jointly infer baseline β, 22 instrumental angles, and four dust EB amplitudes.
